games.name: Kem Malaysia Simulator
games.desc:
Selamat datang ke Kem Malaysia Ops, simulasi gabungan Polis dan Tentera Malaysia yang  realistik di Roblox! Bersedia untuk menghadapi latihan ketenteraan yang mencabar dan operasi penguatkuasaan undang-undang yang kritikal.

Pilih Jalan Anda:

👮 Unit Polis (PDRM):

Laksanakan tugas penguatkuasaan, jaga keselamatan kem, dan kendalikan insiden domestik.

Latihan CQB (Pertempuran Jarak Dekat) dan pengendalian situasi tebusan.

Fokus pada undang-undang dan ketenteraman.

💂 Unit Tentera (ATM):

Jalani latihan fizikal yang keras dan simulasi pertempuran taktikal.

Terlibat dalam latihan hutan, kemahiran menembak, dan mengendalikan aset berat.

Fokus pada pertahanan dan operasi khas.


MASUK SEKARANG!
Gagah Setia, Sedia Berkorban.

Tags: #kem #Kem #pdrm #atm #roleplay #polis #askar #malaysia #simulator #Malaysia

games.name: Cursed Gear [V0.83]
games.desc:
The world is being dragged into its next age. In Cursed Gear, your mind is that of the human you used to be, but the form you wield is metal-cold, filled with unlimited potential.

Undertake missions on expeditions in the Eastern Lands of Gaia and in Containment Zone 4, one of the last bastions of humanity and the testing grounds for the DARE Program.

Harness the potential of your android form by equipping powerful cybernetic enhancements, hone your own techniques, and learn from the memories of forgotten masters.

Create powerful factions with trustworthy allies, crush your rivals, and forge a legacy as humanity’s last hope.

Push back the threats encroaching from beyond the wall, and take humanity’s next step forward.
